basics.name: Emanuele Della Valle
basics.label: Associate Professor; Streaming Data Analytics & Stream Reasoning
basics.summary: Associate Professor at Politecnico di Milano (since 2020) and Chief Research Officer at motus ml (since 2023). Research spans streaming machine learning, time series analytics, continual learning, EdgeAI, and knowledge representation/reasoning on evolving data streams. Founder/co-founder of startups Fluxedo, Quantia Consulting, and motus ml; initiated the Stream Reasoning research field (2007).

work.name: Politecnico di Milano
work.position: Associate Professor (Professore Associato), Department of Electronics, Information and Bioengineering (DEIB)
work.summary: Research and teaching on streaming data analytics, stream reasoning, and semantic technologies.
highlights: Started the Stream Reasoning research field (2007) at the intersection of stream processing and AI.
Industrial collaborations on streaming reasoning (Telecom Italia, IBM, Siemens, Oracle, Indra, Statoil).
Scientific Director roles for executive Masters (Analytics & BI; Big Data Engineering; Big Data Science).

work.name: motus ml s.r.l. S.B. (Politecnico di Milano spin-off)
work.summary: EdgeAI solutions for continuous analysis of data flows from IoT devices (often intermittently connected).
highlights: Co-founder; company launched to exploit research on Streaming Data Analytics.
Focus on EdgeAI for IoT data flows.

work.name: Politecnico di Milano
work.position: Assistant Professor (Ricercatore di Ruolo confermato), DEIB
work.summary: Academic research, teaching, and service in semantic technologies, stream processing, and data science.
highlights: Developed early RDF stream processing and stream reasoning systems (e.g., C-SPARQL Engine).
Organized Stream Reasoning workshop series (multiple editions since 2009).

work.name: CEFRIEL
work.summary: Led CEFRIEL’s Semantic Web Practice; worked on strategic consultancy projects in eBusiness, eGovernment, and eHealth.
highlights: Founded and coordinated the Semantic Web Practice (from 2003).
Worked on strategic consultancy IT projects (2001–2004).
